# Harnez Rules

Generated by `harnez init`; do not edit. Read these rules in addition to AGENTS.md:

> This repo does not use file-based issues; skip those steps and use the repo's own tracker.
> When its tickets live on the forge of the origin remote (no issues/ dir), search with `harnez find -d . issues "<terms>"`,
> read with `harnez issues show N`, and file with `harnez issues new "<title>" -F <body-file> [--label L]`;
> each prints the forge repo. Ask before commenting on an existing ticket, and report "filed as #N at <URL>; no commit".

> This repo does not use indexed studies; skip those steps.
